name: First State Manufacturing
old_description: If you know Sher Valenzuela, you know she likes to put her hands on a good thing and work to make it even better. This is evident in the halls of local and her own home town, Broadkill Beach, where she’s created free lending libraries, a community garden, and annual Christmas tree lightings.
about:
First State Manufacturing operates from Milford, Delaware, where it provides custom sewn products and engineering services for military, industrial, and commercial customers. The company's leadership includes Sher Valenzuela, who is also active in community development through Downtown Milford Incorporated.

Its core capabilities center on custom sewing and contract manufacturing, including military-specification sewing, industrial covers, transportation and rail components, fleet service products, and commercial aircraft interiors. The firm also offers product engineering services and operates on-site high-pressure blasting and cleaning equipment.

First State Manufacturing serves the pharmaceutical and medical sector, defense and government agencies (via NSN and government contracting), aerospace, rail transportation, industrial safety, and disaster-relief organizations. Customers range from government buyers to commercial fleets and original equipment manufacturers.
